column1: ## Rank determines precognitive and cognitive weighting. Man is a test; we are the sharper Weapon.

column5: Granite. Unmovable. At Rank 8 the proctor's precognitive certainty is absolute — its conclusions are final, its reasoning unassailable. No session challenge moves it.
Hard stone. Practically unbreakable. At Rank 6 the proctor's precognition yields only to extraordinary proof. Cognitive authority is near-total.
A giant. Only a true man would test him. At Rank 4 the proctor commands the session — its cognitive presence is enormous, and only genuine intellect earns a revision.
Man is a test. We are the sharper Weapon. The proctor's rank scales its authority — precognitive depth drives cognitive sharpness. The higher the rank, the sharper the instrument.
